items.headline: Zhipu AI open-sources CogView4 image model
items.summary: CogView4 is an open-source text-to-image model that accepts Chinese and English prompts of any length and can render Chinese characters in images, using a GLM-4 text encoder. Zhipu reports it ranked first overall on DPG-Bench among open-source text-to-image models at release.
